title: Label
description: A person's verdict on one detection, one JSON object per line in content/labels/<area>.jsonl. A later line for the same detection replaces an earlier one.

box.description: The detection's bounding box when labelled, so a label is dropped if detection is rerun and the id now points at another object.

action.description: accept: the match is right. relabel: it is the given clue. reject: not a real object of this category. unknown: a real object that matches no clue yet.
